releases.title: Compact check-ins, Daily Quiz tiers, and SmoothStars
changes: Temp Check and Daily Quiz use smaller centered popups. All six moods, including Chilling, fit in one row.
Temp Check and Daily Quiz tabs and automatic prompts appear only on Home. Points and SmoothStar progress now live in the sidebar.
Each day offers one Easy question worth 5 points, one Medium worth 10, and one Very Hard worth 15. Correct answers play a brief celebration that respects reduced-motion settings.
Every 100 points earns a SmoothStar sticker. Quiz wording is shorter, and completed quizzes invite employees to come back tomorrow.
Smooth can review all three daily answers and tier-specific scores in Team. Earlier scores and answer history remain intact.
An additive database migration, server-graded tier limits, and duplicate protection preserve prior records and prevent extra awards across devices.
Smaller centered Temp Check and Daily Quiz popups appear only on Home. Chilling joins the six mood choices in one row.
Answer up to three questions daily: Easy for 5 points, Medium for 10, and Very Hard for 15. A correct answer plays a quick celebration.
Find your points and SmoothStar progress in the sidebar. Every 100 points earns a SmoothStar; your previous points and answers are kept.
Daily Quiz replaces Daily creative, with shorter wording and difficulty buttons to move between today’s questions.

releases.title: Temp Check, daily creative questions, and studio stars
changes: Employees get a dismissible Temp Check at the top of the dashboard every three hours, with five self-reported mood choices.
A daily creative question rotates across camera basics, exposure, video, lighting, and audio. The answer explanation appears after submitting.
Each correct daily answer earns 10 permanent points. Every 100 points unlocks a digital star sticker, with progress and recent answers available from the top bar.
Smooth can review employee mood check-ins, correct and incorrect answers, points, and stars in Team. Employees see only their own records.
Server-side daily limits, duplicate protection, private storage, and Eastern-time date handling keep results consistent across devices. Moods never affect points or rental pay.
Deployment checks allow time for new server capabilities to become available before enabling the update.
Temp Check lets you share how you feel with Smooth every three hours while using the dashboard. You can skip it, and moods do not affect points.
Answer one daily creative question to practice your craft. A correct answer earns 10 points; an explanation follows every submitted answer.
Watch your points grow in the top bar and collect a digital star sticker every 100 points. Open your progress to see recent answers.
Only you and Smooth can see your check-ins and results. A new question arrives each day at midnight Eastern.

releases.title: Preferred work days and time off in one Availability section
changes: Employees can add, edit, and remove preferred work days or specific hours, with optional weekly repeats.
Availability combines work preferences with existing class and personal time blocks; Home now links directly to it.
Smooth can review each employee’s availability, see preferences on the weekly schedule, and distinguish full, partial, and unstated preferences while assigning work.
Blocked time and existing work still flag conflicts. Preferences never create an assignment or earnings, and assignment acceptance remains required.
Preferences are stored privately with the scheduling service. Employees see only their own entries; Smooth can manage the team’s entries.
Use Availability to choose the days or hours you want to work and block time you cannot work.
Add a full day or specific hours, repeat it weekly, and edit or remove work preferences later.
The Home shortcut opens Availability. Smooth sees your preferences when offering work; you still confirm an assignment by accepting it.
